decisions.reason: The candidate already has a complete same-message MODIFY establishing the 5V supply, required level shifter, and 74AHCT1G125 part.
Selecting the LED level-shifter part does not change the requested assembly-order settings, pricing, or availability review.
The specified LCSC part is a component-level selection and does not modify the candidate's general sourcing policy or existing connector sourcing decisions.
Replacing the LED level-shifter part does not change the requirement that KiCad footprints and project resources resolve portably.
The 5V rail already includes the SK6812 LEDs as powered loads, and the source does not change rail control, voltage, converter, or shutdown behavior.
The level-shifter replacement does not alter the LED power-cutoff behavior, GPIO5 control, or zero-standby-current target.
The board remains an eight-LED SK6812 indicator board; its supply and data-level circuitry is owned by the separate addressable LED power-and-logic Requirement.
The SK6812 5V supply and data-level shifter do not change the standalone USB 3.3V regulator or its unresolved current-capacity question.
The referenced data line is the SK6812 control line, not the native USB programming or enumeration interface.
The LED level-shifter selection does not alter the AXP2101 battery, USB, VMID, VSYS, or 3.3V power-path topology.
The source specifies a level-shifter component but does not change any ESP32-S3 GPIO assignment or compatibility constraint.
